newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo names Carlos Sales as Nafin head. [CORRECTED 18:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo names Carlos Sales as Nafin head. [CORRECTED 18:44 GMT]

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo appointed Senator Carlos Sales as new director general of national development bank Nacional Financiera (Nafin), the president's office announced on Thursday.
(Corrects above to confirm Sales not a former Senator).
Zedillo "agreed to designate Senator Carlos Sales as director general of Nacional Financiera to replace Gilberto Borja," a statement from the president's office said.
Borja, a prominent Mexican businessman, resigned on Tuesday for health reasons.
The statement from the president's office said the appointment would take effect as soon as Sales, a senator for the state of Campeche, was granted leave by the permanent commission of Congress.
Sales is currently chairman of the Senate Finance Committee.

An economics graduate of the Autonomous Technical Institute of Mexico (ITAM), Sales is a former head of financial planning at Nafin and a deputy director general of public credit at the Finance Ministry.
Sales has also represented Mexico in several international organizations, including the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund and the Inter-American Development Bank.
